name: ash-desktop
description: Electron client for the Ash app-server protocol

scripts.protocol:generate: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p ash-app-server-protocol --bin generate_protocol -- typescript --out generated/app-server
scripts.prepare:generated: pnpm run protocol:generate && pnpm run icons:check
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.prebuild:host: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.prebuild:main: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.prebuild:preload: pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.prebuild:renderer: pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.predev: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated && node ../build/package/prepare.ts
scripts.predev:ui: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.predev:electron: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated && node ../build/package/prepare.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node ../build/desktop/verifySandboxPreload.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && vite build --config ../build/vite/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:main: pnpm run test:build-tools && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:extensions: node test/unit/clean.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.extensions-test.json && node test/unit/extensions.ts
scripts.test:unit: node test/unit/clean.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/unit/run.ts
scripts.test:editor:unit: node test/unit/clean.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/unit/editor.ts
scripts.test:editor: pnpm run test:editor:unit && pnpm run test:editor:browser
scripts.pretest:smoke:ui: pnpm run build && node ../build/package/prepare.ts && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:smoke:browser:debug: pnpm run pretest:smoke:browser && cross-env ASH_PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER=disconnected playwright test --project=browser-ui --debug
scripts.test:loading: cross-env ASH_LOADING_BASELINE=1 corepack pnpm run test:smoke:browser:full --grep 'production loading baseline' --repeat-each=3
scripts.pretest:smoke:desktop: pnpm run build && node ../build/package/prepare.ts && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest:app: pnpm run build && node ../build/package/prepare.ts && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest:app:pdf-corpus: pnpm run build && node ../build/package/prepare.ts && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node ../build/desktop/verifySandboxPreload.ts && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host,app-server "vite --config ../build/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DEV_APP_SERVER_RELOAD=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/desktop/watch/electron.ts" "node ../build/desktop/watch/appServer.ts --skip-initial"
scripts.dev:ui: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node ../build/desktop/verifySandboxPreload.ts && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host "vite --config ../build/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DESKTOP_UI_ONLY=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/desktop/watch/electron.ts"
scripts.build:web: tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && cross-env ASH_WEB_APP_SERVER=1 vite build --config ../build/vite/vite.config.ts
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DEV_APP_SERVER_RELOAD=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/desktop/watch/electron.ts
scripts.prestart: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated && node ../build/package/prepare.ts
